description: Implementation of NG Setup Procedure for NGAP in 5G network, including handling retries, timeouts, and response processing.

classes.name: ng_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles NG Setup procedure including retries, timeouts, and response handling in NGAP.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the NG setup process, handling message exchange, retries, and result creation.

methods.name: retry_required
methods.description: Determines if the NG setup procedure should be retried based on the last response or failure.

methods.name: create_ng_setup_result
methods.description: Constructs the result of the NG setup procedure based on the success or failure of the transaction.

methods.name: is_failure_misconfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a failure cause indicates a misconfiguration, which should not be retried.
